transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I guess... it's mostly just stuff at work. I'm a transportation inspector, and... well, ever since I got this county safety award, things have been off. Certain people have been... twisting my inspection reports around. They keep asking these really pointed budget questions, like they're trying to make me look crooked or something. 

My supervisor just tells me it's a normal review, but... it's not. I can tell. There's a coordinated effort to discredit me going on. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Aside from noticing these actions at work, have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one was around, or that other people couldn't hear?
No. I... no. I don't hear things like that. It's just the people at the office.
Have you noticed similar issues with trusting people in other parts of your life, such as with friends or family, or is this strictly limited to your workplace?

No, it's... mostly just work. Everything else is fine. 

I mean, I still get to work on time, do my inspections... I keep up with church and just take care of myself. It's not like my whole life is falling apart. The main problems really just come up when... well, when people start bringing up those reports. Or when they question my spending. But outside of that... I'm fine.
How long have you felt that this coordinated effort against you has been going on?
About a year, I guess. It... started right around the time I got recognized for that county safety initiative. That's when things changed.
